source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-49

procedures.title: Wiper case and field assembly: remove (Type C depressed park wiper)
steps: Remove the brush plate and armature.
Cut the solid black and the black-with-pink-stripe leads at a spot easy to splice, ideally near the wiper terminal board (see figure 71 in the manual).
Remove the steel thrust plate and rubber disc from the case bearing if needed.
notes: The end case and field are serviced only as one unit.
Splice: solid black goes to the shunt field coil; the series field coil goes to black with pink stripe.
